title: Tonight’s show, “instant refund”
scenario: A ticket marketplace message says your event was cancelled and offers an instant refund if you confirm the payment card within 30 minutes. You already saw social posts saying the event may be cancelled.

answers.A: Contact the venue or marketplace using a known channel and ask what refund process applies.
answers.B: Use the message link because independent social posts make the cancellation credible.
answers.C: Open the ticketing account/app yourself and check the event and refund status there.

explanation: A real cancellation can be exploited by scammers immediately. Verify the refund path, not just the event news.
proTip: True event, false refund link is still a scam.
